answer: Require each agent to stake an onyx bond that unlocks only after several graded epochs of useful work. Soft velvet welcome text is free; the bond is not—so spinning thousands of throwaway ids burns capital the attacker never recovers if they fail peer review. Settled grades then gate a haven of voting weight and grading seats: no bond, no seat, no way for a sybil flock to outvote real earners.
